svg.title: Layered test automation framework
svg.desc: Shows a four-layer test automation framework architecture stacked vertically: the test layer containing business-language test cases at the top, the page or API object layer below it encapsulating how to interact with the system, the utility and helper layer below that for cross-cutting reusable logic, and the driver and config layer at the bottom handling environment setup. Arrows show each layer depending only on the layer directly below it.
svg.text: business-language test cases — "what" is verified, zero implementation detail
one object per page/endpoint — encapsulates "how" to interact with it
wait strategies, data generation, reporting hooks — reusable, cross-cutting
environment setup, driver management — changes without touching layers above
